CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.MobS_EksportTwr @CentrumID INT, -- ID centrum praw struktury firmy - id mobilnego sprzedawcy @TypEksportu INT, -- Typ eksportu (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) @PackageSize INT, -- Rozmiar paczki @PackageNumber INT -- Numer paczki AS BEGIN DECLARE @Typ_GrT SMALLINT DECLARE @GrOTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GrONumer INT DECLARE @Stany0Exp INT DECLARE @TimeStamp INT DECLARE @MMPbezZasobow TABLE ( gidnumer int ) DECLARE @dodatkoweTwr TABLE ( gidnumer int )
SET @Typ_GrT = -16 SET @Stany0Exp=1 UPDATE CDN.PicoKonfig SET PcK_TSSynchrTwr = DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(datetime,'1990-01-01',120),CONVERT(datetime,GetDate(),120)) WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4 SELECT @GrOTyp=PcK_TwGTyp, @GrONumer=PcK_TwGNumer, @TimeStamp=PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4
IF ISNULL(@GrOTyp,0) = @Typ_GrT BEGIN INSERT INTO @MMPbezZasobow SELECT TrE_Gidnumer FROM ( SELECT TrE_GIDNumer, TrE_TwrNumer, sum(TrS_Ilosc) as Ilosc, TrS_MagNumer, TrS_DstNumer FROM CDN.PicoKonfig JOIN CDN.TraNag ON PcK_MagNumer=TrN_MagDNumer AND TrN_GIDTyp=1604 AND TrN_TrNLp=127 AND TrN_Stan>=3 JOIN CDN.TraElem ON TrN_GIDNumer=TrE_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.TraSElem ON TrE_GIDNumer=TrS_GIDNumer AND TrE_GIDLp=TrS_GIDLp WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND TrN_OddDokID<=0 GROUP BY TrE_GIDNumer, TrS_MagNumer, TrE_TwrNumer, TrS_DstNumer ) X JOIN CDN.TwrZasoby ON Twz_MagNumer=Trs_MagNumer AND Twz_TwrNumer=Tre_TwrNumer AND Twz_DstNumer=Trs_DstNumer WHERE Ilosc>Twz_IlSpr
INSERT INTO @dodatkoweTwr SELECT TrE_TwrNumer FROM CDN.PicoKonfig JOIN CDN.TraNag ON PcK_MagNumer=TrN_MagDNumer AND TrN_GIDTyp=1604 AND TrN_TrNLp=127 AND TrN_Stan>=3 JOIN CDN.TraElem ON TrN_GIDNumer=TrE_GIDNumer WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND TrN_OddDokID<=0 AND TrE_GIDNumer NOT IN (SELECT gidnumer FROM @MMPbezZasobow) END
SELECT DISTINCT identity(int,1,1) AS Rank, * INTO #TempMobile FROM ( SELECT Twr_GIDNumer, ISNULL(Twr_Typ,1) As Twr_Typ, ISNULL(Twr_Kaucja,0) As Twr_Kaucja, ISNULL(Twr_Archiwalny,0) As Twr_Archiwalny, ISNULL(Twr_Blokada,0) As Twr_Blokada, ISNULL(Twr_Nazwa,'') As Twr_Nazwa, ISNULL(Twr_Kod,'') As Twr_Kod, ISNULL(Twr_Ean,'') As Twr_Ean, ISNULL(Twr_Katalog,'') As Twr_Symbol, ISNULL(Twr_Jm,'szt.') As Twr_Jm, ISNULL(b.Naz_GIDLp,0) As Twr_JmID, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(Twr_JMCalkowita,0) = 1 THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(Twr_JmFormat,4) END) as Twr_JmFormat, ISNULL(Twr_Sww,'') As Twr_Sww, ISNULL(Twr_URL,'') As Twr_URL, (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FRO_GIDLp FROM CDN.FrmObiekty WHERE FRO_FRMID = @CentrumID AND FRO_GIDTyp = 64 AND FRO_GIDLp = Twr_CenaSpr) THEN Twr_CenaSpr ELSE FRS_CenaDomyslna END) AS Twr_CenaSpr, ISNULL(Twr_BezRabatu,0) As Twr_BezRabatu, ISNULL(Twr_MarzaMin,0) As Twr_MarzaMin, ISNULL(Twr_EdycjaNazwy,0) As Twr_EdycjaNazwy, ISNULL(Twr_KosztUslugi,0) As Twr_KosztUslugi, ISNULL(Twr_KosztUTyp,0) As Twr_KosztUTyp, ISNULL(Twr_GrupaPod,'A') As Twr_GrupaPod, ISNULL(Twr_GrupaPodSpr,'A') As Twr_GrupaPodSpr, a.Naz_gidlp As Twr_GrupaPodSprID, ISNULL(Twr_SKNId,0) As Twr_SKNId, ISNULL(Twr_PartiaDataW,0) As Twr_PartiaDataW, ISNULL(Twr_TerminW,0) As Twr_TerminW, ISNULL(Twr_LastModC,0) As Twr_LastModC, ISNULL(Twr_CCKNumer,0) As Twr_CCKNumer, ISNULL(Twr_Waga,0) As Twr_Waga, ISNULL(Twr_WJm,'') As Twr_WJm, ISNULL(Twr_PrdNumer,0) As Twr_Producent, ISNULL(Twr_MarkaId,0) As Twr_Marka, ISNULL(Twr_Notowania,0) As Twr_KategoriaRynkowa, ISNULL(TGD_GrONumer,0) AS Twr_GrupaDom FROM CDN.TwrKarty JOIN CDN.TwrLinki ON Twr_GIDTyp=TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer=TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrOTyp = @GrOTyp AND TwL_GrONumer = @GrONumer JOIN CDN.Nazwy a ON ISNULL(Twr_GrupaPodSpr,'A')=left(rtrim(a.Naz_Nazwa),1) AND ISNULL(Twr_StawkaPodSpr,22)=CAST(left(rtrim(a.Naz_Nazwa1),5) as decimal(5,2)) AND a.Naz_GIDTyp=624 JOIN CDN.Nazwy b ON Twr_Jm=b.Naz_Nazwa AND b.Naz_GIDTyp=144 JOIN CDN.FrmStruktura ON FrS_ID=@CentrumID LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.TwrGrupyDom ON Twr_GIDTyp=TGD_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer=TGD_GIDNumer WHERE Twr_GIDNumer>0 AND Twr_Aktywna=0 AND Twr_Typ<>3 AND Twr_MobSpr=1 AND Twr_LastModC>CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN @TimeStamp ELSE 0 END AND Twr_Archiwalny<CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND (EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.TwrCeny JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON PcK_CentrumID = @CentrumID AND PcK_Typ = 4 LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.FrmObiekty ON FRO_FRMID = PcK_CentrumID AND FRO_GIDTyp = 64 AND FRO_GIDLp = TwC_TwrLp WHERE TwC_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer AND (FRO_GIDLp IS NOT NULL OR (PcK_CenaZakupu = 1 AND TwC_TwrLp = 0 )))) --(@Stany0Exp = CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.TwrZasoby JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON TwZ_MagNumer=PcK_MagNumer AND PcK_CentrumID = @CentrumID WHERE TwZ_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END OR @Stany0Exp=1) UNION SELECT Twr_GIDNumer, ISNULL(Twr_Typ,1) As Twr_Typ, ISNULL(Twr_Kaucja,0) As Twr_Kaucja, ISNULL(Twr_Archiwalny,0) As Twr_Archiwalny, ISNULL(Twr_Blokada,0) As Twr_Blokada, ISNULL(Twr_Nazwa,'') As Twr_Nazwa, ISNULL(Twr_Kod,'') As Twr_Kod, ISNULL(Twr_Ean,'') As Twr_Ean, ISNULL(Twr_Katalog,'') As Twr_Symbol, ISNULL(Twr_Jm,'szt.') As Twr_Jm, ISNULL(b.Naz_GIDLp,0) As Twr_JmID, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(Twr_JMCalkowita,0) = 1 THEN 0 ELSE ISNULL(Twr_JmFormat,4) END) as Twr_JmFormat, ISNULL(Twr_Sww,'') As Twr_Sww, ISNULL(Twr_URL,'') As Twr_URL, (CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT FRO_GIDLp FROM CDN.FrmObiekty WHERE FRO_FRMID = @CentrumID AND FRO_GIDTyp = 64 AND FRO_GIDLp = Twr_CenaSpr) THEN Twr_CenaSpr ELSE FRS_CenaDomyslna END) AS Twr_CenaSpr, ISNULL(Twr_BezRabatu,0) As Twr_BezRabatu, ISNULL(Twr_MarzaMin,0) As Twr_MarzaMin, ISNULL(Twr_EdycjaNazwy,0) As Twr_EdycjaNazwy, ISNULL(Twr_KosztUslugi,0) As Twr_KosztUslugi, ISNULL(Twr_KosztUTyp,0) As Twr_KosztUTyp, ISNULL(Twr_GrupaPod,'A') As Twr_GrupaPod, ISNULL(Twr_GrupaPodSpr,'A') As Twr_GrupaPodSpr, a.Naz_gidlp As Twr_GrupaPodSprID, ISNULL(Twr_SKNId,0) As Twr_SKNId, ISNULL(Twr_PartiaDataW,0) As Twr_PartiaDataW, ISNULL(Twr_TerminW,0) As Twr_TerminW, ISNULL(Twr_LastModC,0) As Twr_LastModC, ISNULL(Twr_CCKNumer,0) As Twr_CCKNumer, ISNULL(Twr_Waga,0) As Twr_Waga, ISNULL(Twr_WJm,'') As Twr_WJm, ISNULL(Twr_PrdNumer,0) As Twr_Producent, ISNULL(Twr_MarkaId,0) As Twr_Marka, ISNULL(Twr_Notowania,0) As Twr_KategoriaRynkowa, ISNULL(TGD_GrONumer,0) AS Twr_GrupaDom FROM CDN.TwrKarty JOIN CDN.Nazwy a ON ISNULL(Twr_GrupaPodSpr,'A')=left(rtrim(a.Naz_Nazwa),1) AND ISNULL(Twr_StawkaPodSpr,22)=CAST(left(rtrim(a.Naz_Nazwa1),5) as decimal(5,2)) AND a.Naz_GIDTyp=624 JOIN CDN.Nazwy b ON Twr_Jm=b.Naz_Nazwa AND b.Naz_GIDTyp=144 JOIN CDN.FrmStruktura ON FrS_ID=@CentrumID LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.TwrGrupyDom ON Twr_GIDTyp=TGD_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer=TGD_GIDNumer WHERE twr_gidnumer in (select gidnumer from @dodatkoweTwr) --AND NOT EXISTS(select * from CDN.TwrLinki where TwL_gidnumer=Twr_GIDNumer AND TwL_GIDTyp=-@Typ_GrT AND TwL_GrOTyp=@GrOTyp AND TwL_GrONumer=@GrONumer) ) TableTmp
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TempMobile
DELETE FROM #TempMobile WHERE Rank <= @packageSize * (@packageNumber - 1) OR Rank > @packageSize * @packageNumber
SELECT * FROM #TempMobile
/*Jednostki pomocnicze*/ SELECT TwJ_TwrNumer, Twj_TwrLp, ISNULL(TwK_Kod, '') As Twj_EAN, ISNULL(TwJ_JednostkaLog,0) As TwJ_JednostkaLog, CASE WHEN TwJ_TwrNumer=Twr.Twr_GIDNumer AND TwJ_TwrLp=Twr.Twr_JMDomyslna THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TwJ_DomyslnaSpr, CASE WHEN TwJ_TwrNumer=Twr.Twr_GIDNumer AND TwJ_TwrLp=Twr.Twr_JMDomyslnaZak THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TwJ_DomyslnaZak, Naz_GIDLp AS TwJ_JmID, TwJ_JmZ AS TwJ_Jm, ISNULL(TwJ_PrzeliczM,1) AS TwJ_PrzeliczM, ISNULL(TwJ_PrzeliczL,1) AS TwJ_PrzeliczL, ISNULL(TwJ_Waga,0) AS TwJ_Waga, ISNULL(TwJ_WJm, '') AS TwJ_WJm, CASE WHEN TwJ_Calkowita = 1 THEN 0 ELSE TwJ_JmFormat END AS TwJ_JmFormat, ISNULL(TwJ_TypJm,1) AS TwJ_TypJm FROM CDN.TwrJm join CDN.TwrKody on TwK_Jm=TwJ_JmZ and TwK_TwrNumer= TwJ_TwrNumer and TwK_Rodzaj=0 JOIN #TempMobile Tmp ON TwJ_TwrNumer=Tmp.Twr_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.TwrKarty Twr ON TwJ_TwrNumer=Twr.Twr_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.Nazwy ON Naz_GIDTyp=144 AND Naz_Nazwa=TwJ_JmZ /*Jednostki pomocnicze koniec*/
/*Atrybuty*/ SELECT Atr_Id, Atr_ObiNumer, CASE WHEN AtK_Typ = 1 THEN CASE WHEN Atr_Wartosc = 'TAK' THEN 'True' WHEN Atr_Wartosc = 'NIE' THEN 'False' ELSE '' END WHEN AtK_Format='@d17' THEN CASE WHEN CONVERT(int, Atr_Wartosc) = 0 THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(varchar, CDN.TsToDate(CONVERT(int, Atr_Wartosc), 0), 105) END ELSE Atr_Wartosc END AS Atr_Wartosc, 0 as Atr_WartoscId, Atr_AtKId FROM CDN.Atrybuty INNER JOIN #TempMobile Tmp ON Atr_ObiNumer=Tmp.Twr_GIDNumer and Atr_ObiTyp = 16 INNER JOIN CDN.AtrybutyKlasy on Atr_AtkId = AtK_ID where AtK_MOBSPrawa>0 AND AtK_Typ <=6 /*Atrybuty koniec*/
SET NOCOUNT ON UPDATE CDN.TwrKarty SET Twr_Oddzialowy = 1 + (Twr_Oddzialowy&2) FROM CDN.TwrKarty Twr JOIN #TempMobile Tmp ON Twr.Twr_GIDNumer=Tmp.Twr_GIDNumer WHERE Twr_Oddzialowy & 1 = 0
DROP TABLE #TempMobile SET NOCOUNT OFF
END

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.MobS_EksportTwZ @CentrumID INT, -- ID centrum praw struktury firmy @TypEksportu INT -- Typ eksportu (0 - zasoby bez magazynu PH, 1 - wszystkie zasoby wraz z magazynem PH) AS BEGIN DECLARE @Typ_GrT SMALLINT SET @Typ_GrT = -16 DECLARE @Typ_Twr SMALLINT SET @Typ_Twr = 16
IF @TypEksportu = 1 BEGIN UPDATE CDN.TraNag SET TrN_OddDokID=1 FROM CDN.PicoKonfig JOIN CDN.TraNag ON PcK_MagNumer=TrN_MagDNumer AND TrN_GIDTyp=1604 AND TrN_TrNLp=127 AND TrN_Stan>=3 WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4 AND TrN_OddDokID<1 END ;
WITH Magazyny(GIDNumer) AS (SELECT a.Mag_GIDNumer FROM ( SELECT Mag_GIDNumer FROM CDN.Magazyny JOIN CDN.FrmObiekty ON Mag_GIDNumer=FRO_GIDNumer WHERE Mag_Pico=0 AND FrO_FRmId=@CentrumID AND Fro_GIDTyp=208 ) a JOIN ( SELECT Mag_GIDNumer FROM CDN.dokdefinicje join cdn.dokrelacje on Dok_Id=DoR_ID join cdn.magazyny on dor_MSNumer=mag_gidnumer WHERE Mag_Pico=0 AND Dok_GIDTyp=9472 and Dok_FrsId=1 and dor_MSTyp=208) b ON a.Mag_GIDNumer=b.Mag_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.DokDefinicje ON Dok_GIDTyp=9472 and Dok_FrsId=@CentrumID ) SELECT TwZ_TwrNumer, TwZ_MagNumer, SUM(TwZ_Ilosc) AS TwZ_Ilosc, 0 As TwZ_Wartosc, 0 As TwZ_DstNumer FROM CDN.TwrZasoby JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON TwZ_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer JOIN Magazyny ON TwZ_MagNumer=GIDNumer JOIN CDN.TwrLinki ON TwL_GIDTyp=@Typ_Twr AND TwZ_TwrNumer=TwL_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4 WHERE Twr_MobSpr=1 AND Twr_Archiwalny<CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND TwL_GrOTyp=@Typ_GrT AND TwL_GrONumer = CASE WHEN PcK_TwGTyp=@Typ_GrT THEN PcK_TwGNumer ELSE 0 END AND TwZ_Ilosc > 0 GROUP BY TwZ_TwrNumer,TwZ_MagNumer UNION ALL SELECT TwZ_TwrNumer, 0, SUM(TwZ_Ilosc) AS TwZ_Ilosc, 0 As TwZ_Wartosc, 0 As TwZ_DstNumer FROM CDN.TwrZasoby JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON TwZ_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer JOIN Magazyny ON TwZ_MagNumer=GIDNumer JOIN CDN.TwrLinki ON TwL_GIDTyp=@Typ_Twr AND TwZ_TwrNumer=TwL_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4 WHERE Twr_MobSpr=1 AND Twr_Archiwalny<CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND TwL_GrOTyp=@Typ_GrT AND TwL_GrONumer = CASE WHEN PcK_TwGTyp=@Typ_GrT THEN PcK_TwGNumer ELSE 0 END AND TwZ_Ilosc > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.DokDefinicje WHERE Dok_FrSId = @CentrumID AND Dok_JedenMagazyn=2) GROUP BY TwZ_TwrNumer UNION ALL SELECT TwZ_TwrNumer, TwZ_MagNumer, TwZ_Ilosc, cast(TwZ_KsiegowaNetto/TwZ_IlSpr as decimal(15,2)) as TwZ_Wartosc, TwZ_DstNumer FROM CDN.TwrZasoby JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON TwZ_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON TwZ_MagNumer=PcK_MagNumer AND PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4 WHERE Twr_MobSpr=1 AND Twr_Archiwalny<CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND @TypEksportu=1 AND TwZ_IlSpr>0 UNION ALL SELECT TwZ_TwrNumer, TwZ_MagNumer, SUM(TwZ_Ilosc) AS TwZ_Ilosc, 0 As TwZ_Wartosc, 0 As TwZ_DstNumer FROM CDN.TwrZasoby JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON TwZ_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON TwZ_MagNumer=PcK_MagNumer AND PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4 WHERE Twr_MobSpr=1 AND Twr_Archiwalny<CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND @TypEksportu = 1 AND TwZ_IlSpr>0 GROUP BY TwZ_TwrNumer,TwZ_MagNumer
END

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.MobS_EksportTwO @CentrumID INT, -- ID centrum praw struktury firmy - id mobilnego sprzedawcy @TypEksportu INT, -- Typ eksportu (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) @PackageSize INT, -- Rozmiar paczki @PackageNumber INT -- Numer paczki AS BEGIN DECLARE @canSynchronize BIT DECLARE @TimeStamp INT DECLARE @GrOTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GrONumer INT
SELECT @canSynchronize = isnull(PcK_ExpTwrOpisy,0) FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4
IF @canSynchronize = 1/*wg XL można synchronizować opisy towarów*/ BEGIN SELECT @TimeStamp=isnull(PcK_TSSynchrTwoPtw,0), @GrOTyp=PcK_TwGTyp, @GrONumer=PcK_TwGNumer FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4
UPDATE CDN.PicoKonfig SET PcK_TSSynchrTwO = DATEDIFF(s,'19900101',GetDate()) WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4
SELECT DISTINCT identity(int,1,1) AS Rank, * INTO #TempMobile FROM ( SELECT Twr_GIDNumer, left(ISNULL(TwO_Opis,''),255) As TwO_Opis, TwO_CzasModyfikacji FROM CDN.TwrKarty JOIN CDN.TwrLinki ON Twr_GIDTyp=TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer=TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrOTyp=@GrOTyp AND TwL_GrONumer=@GrONumer JOIN CDN.TwrOpisy ON Twr_GIDNumer=TwO_TwrNumer AND TwO_Jezyk=0 WHERE Twr_GIDNumer>0 AND Twr_Aktywna=0 AND Twr_Typ<>3 AND Twr_MobSpr=1 AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(ISNULL(TwO_Opis,''))))>0 AND ISNULL(TwO_CzasModyfikacji,0)>CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN @TimeStamp ELSE 0 END ) TempTwO
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TempMobile
DELETE FROM #TempMobile WHERE Rank <= @packageSize * (@packageNumber - 1) OR Rank > @packageSize * @packageNumber
SELECT * FROM #TempMobile END END

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.MobS_EksportTwC @CentrumID INT, -- ID centrum praw struktury firmy - id mobilnego sprzedawcy @TypEksportu INT, -- Typ eksportu (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) @PackageSize INT, -- Rozmiar paczki @PackageNumber INT -- Numer paczki AS BEGIN DECLARE @Typ_GrT SMALLINT DECLARE @GrOTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GrONumer INT DECLARE @TimeStamp INT DECLARE @MMPbezZasobow TABLE ( gidnumer int ) DECLARE @dodatkoweTwr TABLE ( gidnumer int )
SET @Typ_GrT = -16 UPDATE CDN.PicoKonfig SET PcK_TSSynchrTwC = DATEDIFF(s,CONVERT(datetime,'1990-01-01',120),CONVERT(datetime,GetDate(),120)) WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4 SELECT @GrOTyp=PcK_TwGTyp, @GrONumer=PcK_TwGNumer, @TimeStamp=PcK_TSSynchrTwCPtw FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4
IF ISNULL(@GrOTyp,0) = @Typ_GrT BEGIN INSERT INTO @MMPbezZasobow SELECT TrE_Gidnumer FROM ( SELECT TrE_GIDNumer, TrE_TwrNumer, sum(TrS_Ilosc) as Ilosc, TrS_MagNumer, TrS_DstNumer FROM CDN.PicoKonfig JOIN CDN.TraNag ON PcK_MagNumer=TrN_MagDNumer AND TrN_GIDTyp=1604 AND TrN_TrNLp=127 AND TrN_Stan>=3 JOIN CDN.TraElem ON TrN_GIDNumer=TrE_GIDNumer JOIN CDN.TraSElem ON TrE_GIDNumer=TrS_GIDNumer AND TrE_GIDLp=TrS_GIDLp WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND TrN_OddDokID<=0 GROUP BY TrE_GIDNumer, TrS_MagNumer, TrE_TwrNumer, TrS_DstNumer ) X JOIN CDN.TwrZasoby ON Twz_MagNumer=Trs_MagNumer AND Twz_TwrNumer=Tre_TwrNumer AND Twz_DstNumer=Trs_DstNumer WHERE Ilosc>Twz_IlSpr
INSERT INTO @dodatkoweTwr SELECT TrE_TwrNumer FROM CDN.PicoKonfig JOIN CDN.TraNag ON PcK_MagNumer=TrN_MagDNumer AND TrN_GIDTyp=1604 AND TrN_TrNLp=127 AND TrN_Stan>=3 JOIN CDN.TraElem ON TrN_GIDNumer=TrE_GIDNumer WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND TrN_OddDokID<=0 AND TrE_GIDNumer NOT IN (SELECT gidnumer FROM @MMPbezZasobow) END
DECLARE @TempMobile TABLE ( Rank int identity(1,1), Twr_GIDNumer int, Twr_CenaSpr smallint, Twr_GrupaPodSpr varchar(1), Twr_StawkaPodSpr decimal(5,2))
INSERT INTO @TempMobile SELECT * FROM ( SELECT Twr_GIDNumer, Twr_CenaSpr, Twr_GrupaPodSpr, Twr_StawkaPodSpr FROM CDN.TwrKarty JOIN CDN.TwrLinki ON Twr_GIDTyp=TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer=TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrOTyp = @GrOTyp AND TwL_GrONumer = @GrONumer JOIN CDN.Nazwy a ON ISNULL(Twr_GrupaPodSpr,'A')=left(rtrim(a.Naz_Nazwa),1) AND ISNULL(Twr_StawkaPodSpr,22)=CAST(left(rtrim(a.Naz_Nazwa1),5) as decimal(5,2)) AND a.Naz_GIDTyp=624 JOIN CDN.Nazwy b ON Twr_Jm=b.Naz_Nazwa AND b.Naz_GIDTyp=144 WHERE Twr_GIDNumer>0 AND Twr_Aktywna=0 AND Twr_Typ<>3 AND Twr_MobSpr=1 AND Twr_Archiwalny<CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND (EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.TwrCeny JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON PcK_CentrumID = @CentrumID AND PcK_Typ = 4 LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.FrmObiekty ON FRO_FRMID = PcK_CentrumID AND FRO_GIDTyp = 64 AND FRO_GIDLp = TwC_TwrLp WHERE TwC_TwrNumer=Twr_GIDNumer AND (FRO_GIDLp IS NOT NULL OR (PcK_CenaZakupu = 1 AND TwC_TwrLp = 0)) AND ISNULL(TwC_CzasModyfikacji,0) > CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN @TimeStamp ELSE 0 END)) UNION SELECT Twr_GIDNumer, Twr_CenaSpr, Twr_GrupaPodSpr, Twr_StawkaPodSpr FROM CDN.TwrKarty JOIN CDN.FrmStruktura ON FrS_ID=@CentrumID WHERE twr_gidnumer in (select gidnumer from @dodatkoweTwr) ) TableTmp ORDER BY Twr_GIDNumer
declare @typycen table (ErpId int, Nazwa varchar(10), NB varchar(1), Widoczna bit, DomyslnaCentrum bit)
insert into @typycen select Naz_GIDLp As ErpID, rtrim(substring(naz_nazwa,1,10)) As Nazwa, substring(naz_nazwa,11,1) as NB, 1 as Widoczna, CASE WHEN FrS_CenaDomyslna=Naz_GIDLp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END As DomyslnaCentrum from CDN.FrmStruktura JOIN CDN.FrmObiekty ON FrS_Id=FRO_FRMID JOIN cdn.nazwy ON Naz_GIDTyp=FRO_GIDTyp and Naz_GIDLp=FRO_GIDLp where FrS_Id=@CentrumID and FRO_GIDTyp=64
insert into @typycen SELECT Dok_CenaBazowa As ErpId, rtrim(substring(naz_nazwa,1,10)) as Nazwa, substring(naz_nazwa,11,1) as NB, 0 as Widoczna, 0 as DomyslnaCentrum FROM CDN.DokDefinicje JOIN CDN.Nazwy on Naz_gidlp=Dok_CenaBazowa and naz_gidtyp=64 WHERE Dok_FrsId=@CentrumID AND Dok_GIDTyp IN (2001,2033,2034,8960,9472) AND Dok_CenaBazowa>0 AND Dok_CenaBazowa NOT IN(SELECT ErpId FROM @typycen)
insert into @typycen (erpid,nazwa,widoczna,domyslnacentrum,nb) values(0,'Zakupu',0,0,'N')
select distinct ErpId, Nazwa, Widoczna, DomyslnaCentrum from @typycen
declare @numerkursu int declare @walutasystemowa int select @numerkursu=kon_wartosc from cdn.konfig where kon_numer=11 select @walutasystemowa=wan_id from cdn.konfig join cdn.walnag on Kon_Numer=211 AND rtrim(WaN_Symbol)=rtrim(Kon_Wartosc)
SELECT DISTINCT identity(int,1,1) AS Rank, * INTO #TempPricesMobile FROM ( SELECT TwC_TwrNumer, Twc_TwrLp, CASE WHEN Kon_System IS NULL THEN (case when Twc_TwrLp=0 then 1 else 0 end) ELSE 1 END As TwC_WanSys, (case when Twc_TwrLp=0 then @walutasystemowa else wan_id end) as TwC_WanId, (Case when Twr_CenaSpr IN (Select ErpId from @typycen) then case when Twr_CenaSpr=TwC_TwrLp then 1 else 0 end else CASE WHEN TwC_TwrLp = (Select ErpId from @typycen where DomyslnaCentrum = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END) as TwC_DomyslnaTwr, convert(decimal(15,4),round(isnull((case when Twc_TwrLp<>0 then isnull(wae_kursl,1)/isnull(wae_kursm,1) else 1 end)*(case when nb='N' then twc_wartosc else twc_wartosc/(1+convert(decimal(15,4),rtrim(substring(Naz_Nazwa1,1,5)))/100) end),0),4)) as TwC_Netto, convert(decimal(15,4),round(isnull((case when Twc_TwrLp<>0 then isnull(wae_kursl,1)/isnull(wae_kursm,1) else 1 end)*(case when nb='B' then twc_wartosc else twc_wartosc*(1+convert(decimal(15,4),rtrim(substring(Naz_Nazwa1,1,5)))/100) end),0),4)) as TwC_Brutto, ISNULL(TwC_CzasModyfikacji,0) As TwC_CzasModyfikacji FROM @TempMobile JOIN cdn.TwrCeny on twc_twrnumer=Twr_GIDNumer JOIN @typycen on erpid=twc_twrlp JOIN cdn.walnag on twc_waluta=wan_symbol left join cdn.walelem on WaN_Symbol=WaE_Symbol and wae_lp=@numerkursu and wae_kursts in (select max(wae_kursts) from cdn.walelem where WaN_Symbol=WaE_Symbol and wae_lp=@numerkursu) JOIN CDN.Nazwy a ON ISNULL(Twr_GrupaPodSpr,'A')=left(rtrim(a.Naz_Nazwa),1) AND ISNULL(Twr_StawkaPodSpr,22)=CAST(left(rtrim(a.Naz_Nazwa1),5) as decimal(5,2)) AND a.Naz_GIDTyp=624 LEFT JOIN CDN.Konfig ON Kon_Numer=211 AND rtrim(WaN_Symbol)=rtrim(Kon_Wartosc) WHERE WaN_Id=@walutasystemowa )TablePricesTmp
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #TempPricesMobile
DELETE FROM #TempPricesMobile WHERE Rank <= @PackageSize * (@PackageNumber - 1) OR Rank > @PackageSize * @PackageNumber
SELECT * FROM #TempPricesMobile
END

Create PROCEDURE CDN.MobS_EksportPrd @CentrumID INT, @TypEksportu INT -- Typ eksportu (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) AS BEGIN
DECLARE @TimeStamp INT DECLARE @GrOTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GrONumer INT
SELECT @TimeStamp= isnull(PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw,0),@GrOTyp=PcK_TwGTyp,@GrONumer=PcK_TwGNumer FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4
SELECT DISTINCT Knt_GIDNumer As Prd_GIDNumer, Knt_Akronim As Prd_Nazwa, Knt_Archiwalny As Prd_Archiwalny FROM CDN.TwrKarty JOIN CDN.TwrLinki ON Twr_GIDTyp=TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer=TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrOTyp = @GrOTyp AND TwL_GrONumer = @GrONumer JOIN CDN.KntKarty ON Twr_PrdTyp=Knt_GIDTyp AND Twr_PrdNumer=Knt_GIDNumer WHERE Twr_GIDNumer>0 AND Twr_Aktywna=0 AND Twr_Typ<>3 AND ISNULL(Twr_LastModC,0)>CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN @TimeStamp ELSE 0 END END

CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.MobS_EksportTwP @CentrumID INT, -- ID centrum praw struktury firmy - id mobilnego sprzedawcy @TypEksportu INT, -- Typ eksportu (0 - roznicowy, 1 - pelny) @PackageSize INT, -- Rozmiar paczki @PackageNumber INT -- Numer paczki AS BEGIN DECLARE @TimeStamp INT DECLARE @GrOTyp SMALLINT DECLARE @GrONumer INT
DECLARE @PcK_PicoID INT,@PcK_TSSynchrPtw INT
SELECT @PcK_PicoID=PcK_PicoID, @GrOTyp=PcK_TwGTyp, @GrONumer=PcK_TwGNumer FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_CentrumID=@CentrumID AND PcK_Typ=4
SELECT @TimeStamp=isnull(PcS_TSSynchrPtw,0) --pobierz czas ostatniej synchronizacji zamiennikow FROM CDN.PicoTimestamp WHERE PcS_PcKID=@PcK_PicoID AND PcS_OBITyp=14600
UPDATE CDN.PicoTimestamp SET PcS_TSSynchr = DATEDIFF(s,'19900101',GetDate()) --update czas wysylania zamiennikow WHERE PcS_PcKID=@PcK_PicoID AND PcS_OBITyp=14600
SELECT Lp, TwP_TwrNumer, TwP_ZamNumer , TwP_Warstwa, TwP_PrzeliczL, TwP_PrzeliczM, Zmieniony FROM (SELECT (Row_Number() over (order by tabela.TwP_TwrNumer)) as Lp, tabela.TwP_TwrNumer, tabela.TwP_ZamNumer , tabela.TwP_Warstwa, tabela.TwP_PrzeliczL, tabela.TwP_PrzeliczM, tabela.Zmieniony FROM ( SELECT TwP_TwrNumer, TwP_ZamNumer , TwP_Warstwa, TwP_PrzeliczL, TwP_PrzeliczM, --jednostronne i obustronne CASE WHEN (TwrA.Twr_LastModC >(CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN @TimeStamp ELSE 0 END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as Zmieniony FROM CDN.TwrPodm JOIN CDN.TwrKarty TwrA on (TwP_TwrNumer = TwrA.Twr_GIDNumer) JOIN CDN.TwrKarty TwrB on (TwP_ZamNumer = TwrB.Twr_GIDNumer) JOIN CDN.TwrLinki A ON 16 = A.TwL_GIDTyp AND TwP_TwrNumer=A.TwL_GIDNumer AND A.TwL_GrOTyp=@GrOTyp AND A.TwL_GrONumer=@GrONumer JOIN CDN.TwrLinki B ON 16 = B.TwL_GIDTyp AND TwP_ZamNumer=B.TwL_GIDNumer AND B.TwL_GrOTyp=@GrOTyp AND B.TwL_GrONumer=@GrONumer WHERE TwP_TwrNumer<>0 and (TwP_Warstwa= 0/*jednostronne*/ or TwP_Warstwa>1/*obustronne*/) AND TwrA.Twr_Aktywna=0 AND TwrB.Twr_Aktywna=0 AND TwrA.Twr_MobSpr=1 AND TwrB.Twr_MobSpr=1 AND ((TwrA.Twr_LastModC>CASE WHEN @TypEksportu = 0 THEN @TimeStamp ELSE 0 END) OR (TwrB.Twr_LastModC>CASE WHEN @TypEksportu = 0 THEN @TimeStamp ELSE 0 END)) AND TwrA.Twr_Archiwalny<CASE WHEN @TypEksportu = 0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND TwrB.Twr_Archiwalny<CASE WHEN @TypEksportu = 0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND TwP_DokRodzaj IN(1,3) -- 1 - Rozchodowe; 3- Rozchodowe i Przychodowe
UNION ALL
SELECT 0, TwP_ZamNumer , TwP_Warstwa, TwP_PrzeliczL, TwP_PrzeliczM,Zmieniony --równoważne FROM ( SELECT Twr_Kod,TwP_TwrNumer, TwP_ZamNumer , TwP_Warstwa, TwP_PrzeliczL, TwP_PrzeliczM , CASE WHEN (Twr_LastModC >(CASE WHEN @TypEksportu = 0 THEN @TimeStamp ELSE 0 END)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as Zmieniony, COUNT(*) over(partition by TwP_Warstwa) as IloscMobilnychWarstwa, --równoważne, conajmniej 2 z jednej warstwy musza należeć do grupy mobilnej MAX(Twr_LastModC) over(partition by TwP_Warstwa) as MaxLastModWarstwa FROM CDN.TwrPodm JOIN CDN.TwrKarty on (TwP_ZamNumer = Twr_GIDNumer) JOIN CDN.TwrLinki ON 16=TwL_GIDTyp AND TwP_ZamNumer=TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrOTyp=@GrOTyp AND TwL_GrONumer=@GrONumer WHERE (TwP_TwrNumer = 0 AND TwP_Warstwa>1)/*równoważne*/ AND Twr_Aktywna=0 AND Twr_Archiwalny<CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND TwP_DokRodzaj IN(1,3) -- 1 - Rozchodowe; 3- Rozchodowe i Przychodowe ) as tabWarstwy where tabWarstwy.IloscMobilnychWarstwa > 1 AND tabWarstwy.MaxLastModWarstwa>CASE WHEN @TypEksportu=0 THEN @TimeStamp ELSE 0 END
) AS tabela
)AS tabela2 WHERE (Lp > (@packageNumber-1)*@packageSize) and (Lp<= @packageSize * @packageNumber)
END
